verdict.rationale: Anrok exposes REST endpoints for customers, transactions, filings, tax IDs and address resolution, and explicitly markets 'Headless Tax' and 'AI Atlas' for agents to query tax data and act via API (anrok-docs-12,15,16,30). However there is no evidence of an MCP server/surface, no documented scoped/limited-permission API keys (only generic key generation, anrok-docs-27), and no explicit endpoint surfacing nexus status or accrued liability as first-class fields; probes for llms.txt/openapi discovery also 404 (anrok-probe-1,2), suggesting limited agent-native discoverability. missing for 10: MCP server/tool surface, scoped/restricted API credentials, explicit nexus-status/accrued-liability read endpoints, independent confirmation of agent use in production.
